name: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Interior Liners
fit: Model Y 2025+ (refresh / "Juniper"), excluding Model Y L
forWho: Owners who want the factory option with raised walls for snow, mud, and spills.
note: Tesla's own TPE liners: driver, passenger, and second-row pieces with integrated cleats. Tesla Shop may require signing in with a Tesla account tied to your vehicle, and stock comes and goes.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Interior Liners (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Rear Trunk + Seatback Liner
fit: Model Y 2025+ (5-seat, Premium/Performance, and 7-seat versions), excluding Model Y L
forWho: People hauling dogs, sports gear, or groceries who fold the rear seats a lot.
note: Trunk liner plus seatback liners that cover the backs of the folded second row. Choose the version that matches your seat configuration.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y All-Weather Rear Trunk + Seatback Liner (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: 3D MAXpider KAGU Series Floor Mats
fit: Model Y 5-seat 2021–2024 (this listing). Separate versions exist for 7-seat and 2025+
forWho: Owners who want a lighter, quieter mat than hard rubber.
note: Three layers: a rubber top, a foam core, and an anti-skid backing. Owners often recommend it. Check the year and seat count before you order, because the 2025+ refresh uses a different part.
imageAlt: 3D MAXpider KAGU Series Floor Mats (product photo from Amazon)

name: TuxMat Custom Floor Mats: Model Y 5-Seater AWD
fit: Model Y 5-seat AWD (check the product page for your model year; RWD and 7-seat have separate listings)
forWho: Owners who want the most footwell and sidewall coverage.
note: Laser-measured mats that go high up the sidewalls. Optional trunk, frunk, and sub-trunk pieces are listed separately on the same page.
imageAlt: TuxMat Custom Floor Mats: Model Y 5-Seater AWD (product photo from TuxMat)

name: WeatherTech FloorLiner / FloorLiner HP
fit: Model Y (choose your model year in WeatherTech's vehicle selector)
forWho: People who want a well-known US brand with a guaranteed-fit policy.
note: Rigid, tray-style liners that catch slush and salt. The HP version is softer and grippier. WeatherTech's Model Y page also lists cargo liners and mud flaps.
imageAlt: WeatherTech FloorLiner / FloorLiner HP (product photo from WeatherTech)

name: WeatherTech No-Drill MudFlaps
fit: Model Y (confirm your model year in WeatherTech's selector)
forWho: Drivers on gravel or winter-salt roads who want to cut rock chips on the rocker panels.
note: No-drill design that mounts to existing fender hardware. Mud flaps change the car's look a bit, and some owners report a small aero or noise trade-off.
imageAlt: WeatherTech No-Drill MudFlaps (product photo from WeatherTech)

name: Husky Liners Weatherbeater Cargo Liner
fit: Model Y (confirm fitment on Husky's vehicle page)
forWho: People who want a rugged, truck-brand cargo liner.
note: Husky's Model Y page also lists X-act Contour floor liners and mud guards. Some of its listings are universal-fit, so confirm each one is Model Y-specific.
imageAlt: Husky Liners Weatherbeater Cargo Liner (product photo from Husky Liners)

name: LinerX Front Trunk (Frunk) Liner
fit: Model Y 2020–2025 (per LinerX listing)
forWho: Anyone who puts wet, dirty, or leaky things in the frunk.
note: A custom-fit tray for the frunk tub. The frunk is a common place for spills that are hard to clean.
imageAlt: LinerX Front Trunk (Frunk) Liner (product photo from LinerX)

name: LinerX Rear Trunk Mat + Trunk Well Liner
fit: Model Y 2020–2025, 5-seater (per LinerX listing)
forWho: Owners who want to cover both the main trunk floor and the sub-trunk well.
note: Sold as separate pieces. The listing offers versions with and without ear-flaps that cover the seatbacks.
imageAlt: LinerX Rear Trunk Mat + Trunk Well Liner (product photo from LinerX)

name: Spigen Sliding Center Console Organizer Upper Tray
fit: Model Y 2021–2024 (also Model 3 2021–2023)
forWho: Pre-refresh owners tired of loose items in the deep center console.
note: A polycarbonate tray that slides to give you access to the lower console. Not for the 2025+ refreshed console.
imageAlt: Spigen Sliding Center Console Organizer Upper Tray (product photo from Spigen)

name: Spigen Sliding Console Organizer with Bottle Holder
fit: Model Y 2025+ ("Juniper")
forWho: Refresh owners who carry a big 32–40 oz water bottle.
note: A sliding tray with an angled bottle holder and a sunglasses slot. Spigen says it fits 32 oz and 40 oz bottles.
imageAlt: Spigen Sliding Console Organizer with Bottle Holder (product photo from Spigen)

name: JOWUA Center Console Tray Organizer
fit: Separate versions for the pre-refresh and refreshed Model 3/Y consoles
forWho: Owners who want a clean OEM-style tray to organize the console.
note: JOWUA sorts its console accessories by console generation, so pick the collection that matches your car.
imageAlt: JOWUA Center Console Tray Organizer (product photo from JOWUA)

name: JOWUA Tempered Glass Screen Protector
fit: Model 3/Y (check the screen size and generation on the listing)
forWho: Owners who want to cut glare and fingerprints or keep the touchscreen from getting scratched.
note: Tempered glass for the center display. Matte versions cut glare but soften the image a little. Screen sizes differ between generations, so match yours exactly.
imageAlt: JOWUA Tempered Glass Screen Protector (product photo from JOWUA)

name: Tesla Model Y Sunshades (Glass Roof / Rear Liftgate)
fit: Model Y 2020–2024
forWho: Owners in hot or sunny climates whose rear passengers bake under the glass roof.
note: Tesla's own mesh shades on a collapsible frame. Tesla says the roof shade blocks 66% of luminous transmittance. They come with a zippered storage pouch.
imageAlt: Tesla Model Y Sunshades (Glass Roof / Rear Liftgate) (product photo from Tesla Shop)

name: BASENOR Model Y Juniper Roof Sunshade
fit: Model Y 2025–2026 ("Juniper") only
forWho: Refresh owners who want a near-blackout roof shade.
note: Foldable shade with clip-in install. BASENOR states it does not fit 2020–2024 cars. Its heat-reduction figures are the maker's own claims.
imageAlt: BASENOR Model Y Juniper Roof Sunshade (product photo from BASENOR)

name: EcoNour Windshield Sun Shade for Model 3 & Y
fit: Model Y and Model 3, 2017–2026 (per EcoNour listing)
forWho: Anyone parking outdoors in summer.
note: A foldable reflective windshield shade with a storage pouch. It's a simple, low-cost item that fits both generations.
imageAlt: EcoNour Windshield Sun Shade for Model 3 & Y (product photo from EcoNour)

name: RPM Tesla Model Y Sub-Trunk Dual Level Organizer
fit: Model Y 2020–2025 (per RPM listing)
forWho: Owners who want to use the deep sub-trunk well without everything piling up.
note: A two-layer insert for the sub-trunk. RPM's Model Y trunk page also has frunk organizers and sill-plate covers.
imageAlt: RPM Tesla Model Y Sub-Trunk Dual Level Organizer (product photo from RPM Tesla)

name: Motrobe Rear Trunk Side Organizer + Mud Flaps Bundle
fit: Model Y 2020–2024 (per Amazon listing)
forWho: Pre-refresh owners who want the side trunk cubbies covered and organized.
note: Side-slot bins with carpeted lids, sold with no-drill mud flaps. A budget bundle that has very few reviews so far, so read the listing carefully.
imageAlt: Motrobe Rear Trunk Side Organizer + Mud Flaps Bundle (product photo from Amazon)

name: Abstract Ocean Premium Mud Flaps for Refreshed Model Y
fit: Model Y 2025+ ("Juniper")
forWho: Refresh owners who want mud flaps from a Tesla-focused shop.
note: Abstract Ocean is a Tesla-focused accessory shop. Its Model Y collection is split by Classic and Refreshed generations.
imageAlt: Abstract Ocean Premium Mud Flaps for Refreshed Model Y (product photo from Abstract Ocean)

name: Abstract Ocean Ultra-Bright Interior Light Bundles
fit: Separate bundles for Classic and Refreshed Model Y
forWho: Owners who find the stock footwell, trunk, or frunk lights too dim.
note: Plug-in LED replacements for the stock interior bulbs. A popular, cheap upgrade. Make sure you order the bundle for your generation.
imageAlt: Abstract Ocean Ultra-Bright Interior Light Bundles (product photo from Abstract Ocean)

name: Hansshow Model Y Juniper Roof Rack Crossbars
fit: Model Y including 2025+ "Juniper" (per Hansshow listing)
forWho: Bikers, skiers, and campers who need roof carrying capacity.
note: No-drill crossbars with T-slots. Roof racks cut range at highway speed, so many owners take them off when they're not in use. Check the listed load rating against your roof box or tent.
imageAlt: Hansshow Model Y Juniper Roof Rack Crossbars (product photo from Hansshow)

name: Tesla Universal Wall Connector
fit: All Model Y (charges any EV through the built-in J1772 adapter)
forWho: Owners with a garage or driveway who want fast, reliable home charging.
note: Tesla says Model Y charges at up to 32 A (7.7 kW) on it. It must be installed by a qualified electrician, and installation costs vary a lot by home.
imageAlt: Tesla Universal Wall Connector (product photo from Tesla Shop)
